word_family.translation: to make someone dishonest, often by offering bribes
dishonest conduct by people in positions of power
able to be bribed or led into dishonest behaviour
impossible to bribe or lead into dishonest behaviour

sentence: The senator's ______ was exposed by investigative journalists after months of research. (corrupt)
explanation: We need a noun naming the dishonest conduct of the senator. The suffix -ion creates a noun from the verb 'corrupt'.
